requirements.title: VERIFY argument restrictions
requirements.definition: STRING shall be character, SET shall be character with the same kind type parameter as STRING, BACK shall be logical, and KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

pending.VERIFY-STRING-character: Positive source controls call VERIFY with default character STRING='ABBA' and STRING=''; source-control mutation uses an integer STRING and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.VERIFY-SET-character-same-kind: Positive source controls use default character SET='AB' with default character STRING; source-control mutation uses a different character kind and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.VERIFY-BACK-logical: Positive controls use BACK absent, BACK=.false., and BACK=.true. on STRING='ABBA' and SET='A' to make direction load-bearing; source-control mutation uses integer BACK.
pending.VERIFY-KIND-scalar-integer-constant-expr: Use KIND=selected_int_kind(18); 7.4.3.1 p2 requires an integer representation method with decimal exponent range at least 18. Assert result kind; source-control mutation uses a nonconstant KIND variable.

pending.VERIFY-result-kind-absent-default: Use VERIFY('ABBA','A') and assert KIND of the result equals KIND(0).

accounting.rationale: Description defines VERIFY as character set non-membership search.
Result Value separates forward search, backward search, and zero-result cases.
Case (i) leftmost non-member for absent or false BACK.
Case (ii) rightmost non-member for true BACK.
Case (iii) zero for all-in-SET or zero-length STRING.
